facts.text: Ella Langley canceled her show in Tulsa, Oklahoma, on Friday night due to a "serious security threat" to fans, venue staff, and her team.
The country star announced the news on social media hours before doors were set to open at the BOK Center.
Here's Where You Can Still Find Tickets to Ella Langley's 'Dandelion' Tour

A statement shared by the venue echoed Langley's post, which added, "The safety and well-being of everyone involved is our absolute priority, and after careful consideration, we have determined that the show cannot proceed." The venue said that information on ticket refunds will be shared soon.
"I know how much time, travel, money, and planning goes into coming to a show, and I can't tell you how sorry I am," Langley continued.
Ella Langley cancelled her October 9 show in Tulsa, Oklahoma.
The show was cancelled due to a "serious security threat", per Rolling Stone .
Ella Langley also confirmed that information regarding ticket refunds "will be shared as soon as possible".

Per NBC News , Tulsa police said on Friday night that "a call was made threatening the lives of people attending the event." They took the threat seriously, having deployed their K-9s, bomb team, and patrols in tandem with venue security.
Tulsa police also apologized to any Ella Langley fans who "came down tonight".
We hope that the rest of Ella Langley's tour isn't disrupted like this.
“Due to a serious security threat involving the safety of fans, venue personnel, and the artist, Ella Langley’s scheduled performance tonight at BOK Center in Tulsa has been canceled.”
Country music fans in Oklahoma won’t be seeing star performer Ella Langley on Friday night.
However, the reasoning behind her concert’s sudden cancellation is very serious.

Her Oklahoma venue released a statement Friday evening prior to the start of the show.
It’s unclear exactly what brought on the decision to cancel Friday night’s show.
However, Langley acknowledged her fans and sent a heartfelt message on social media for the disappointed country community.

Country singer Ella Langley canceled her sold-out show slated for Friday evening in Tulsa, Oklahoma, due to what she described as “a serious security threat.” The 27-year-old star announced the last-minute cancellation on Instagram, saying the threat involved “the safety of my fans, the venue staff, and my team.” “The incredibly difficult decision was made to cancel tonight’s show,” she said.
The show was set to take place at Tulsa’s BOK Center, which shared the same statement Langley included in her post on social media.
Police said that it advised Langley’s staff that no credible threat was found, “but they decided to cancel the performance anyway.” “We apologize to everyone who came down tonight.
